# The Pitch

> > The Pitch is a multi-purpose entertainment venue in Kortrijk offering karaoke booths, live concerts, comedy shows, sports viewing, and special events.

Located at Moorseelsestraat 113a in Heule (Kortrijk), The Pitch operates as Studio 8501 GCV and provides private karaoke rooms like Green Grass and Black Velvet, hosts live music and stand-up comedy, and partners with local brands like Brouwerij Omer and KV Kortrijk for community events.

## Key Topics

- Karaoke booths and private rooms
- Comedy shows and open mic nights
- Live concerts and music events
- Sports viewing (KV Kortrijk, Belgian national team)
- Birthday parties and group bookings
- Kortrijk nightlife and entertainment
- Heule Kweelt promotions
- Gift vouchers and cadeaubons
- Venue reservations and pricing
- Casino nights and charity events
- Silent disco events
- Moorseelsestraat 113a location
- Studio 8501 GCV operations
- Brouwerij Omer partnership
